title: Add independent review of the study capability M1 design
summary: Write an independent written review of docs/design/study-capability-m1.md, answering the eight checks in its §9 Review gate, and save it in docs/design/reviews/ like the v0 reviews. The design is not edited and nothing is built.

defaults_applied.how: Review findings cite design sections and BRIEF.md lines.
Design is reviewed before it is built, as the design's review gate requires.
One new review document; the design itself is not edited.
Review is written for an outside reader.
Recovered the review checklist from §9 of the design instead of asking.

assumptions: 'Reviewed independently' means producing a written review document of docs/design/study-capability-m1.md per its §9, as the v0 reviews were done, not building anything.
The producer acts as a reviewer with no shared context with the design's author and does not edit the design to fix findings; answering findings is a later job.
The review is written to docs/design/reviews/ as a new markdown file.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new review file exists under docs/design/reviews/ (named like study-capability-m1-review-1.md) that reviews docs/design/study-capability-m1.md.
The review addresses each of the eight checks listed in §9 of the design, in order, with a verdict and cited evidence (section or BRIEF.md line) for each.
Every finding has a severity (blocker, major, minor, or nit), and the review ends with an overall verdict stating whether the design may proceed to build.
The review is written independently of the design's author context, in the style of the existing athena-v0 reviews in docs/design/reviews/, and contains no secrets or personal data.
Only the review file (and at most a CHANGELOG entry or a status/pointer line in the design) changes; no Rust code, config, or governance files change.
Run `git status` and `git diff`: only docs/ files (and optionally CHANGELOG.md) are changed; `cargo fmt --check` still passes.

out_of_scope: Editing the design to answer findings
Building any part of the study capability
Changing code, config, or governance files
departures: Slightly higher cost than reference: the producer must read the whole design and BRIEF.md to review it.
